nodes.label: Song mutation lifecycle state
nodes.intent: Tracks song mutation through its lifecycle: synced, pending operations, in-flight sends, cancellation tombstones, and conflict states
invariants: Monotonic state progression: synced -> pending*, pending* -> sending -> synced/conflict
pendingCreate can transition to sending (in-flight marker) or cancelling (deletion during create)
cancelling is a transient state only resolvable by resolveCancelledSongCreate
Only synced or pending* mutations are visible in read queries
cancelling mutations are hidden from all local-first reads

Empty snapshot resolution with pending confirmation markers
Song mutation lifecycle (CRUD operations)
Local revision tracking for optimistic concurrency control
In-flight create marking and cancellation resolution
Storage write recovery and eviction integration

Filter out synced mutations and deletions

nodes.label: SQLite-based song catalog store

nodes.label: Empty list response durability gate
nodes.intent: D4 pattern: decides whether an incoming empty listSongs() may replace non-empty stored snapshot
variants: accept: no stored snapshot, already empty, or second confirmation
reject: non-empty stored + first empty response (sets pending marker)
